name: io.github.ystoneman/geospatial
description: Geospatial toolkit: coordinates, geocoding, routing, terrain, weather and radio links. 22 tools, no API key required.

environmentVariables.name: GEO_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Toolsets to enable: default, all, offline, or a comma-separated list.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTESERVICE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional routing upgrade. The keyless default is Valhalla.

environmentVariables.name: OPENCELLID_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional cell-tower database. The keyless default is BeaconDB.
